content:
marie: Polaris Legal (acct polaris-223) onboarding is blocked — EU pilots are getting 429s on /v1/complete. Renewal check-in in 3 weeks; customer is pretty nervous. Can we do a temporary rate bump + IP allowlist + spin up a regional edge for them? :worried:

sam: Ack. Need numbers — what's their current RL, peak QPS, and a contact for IPs? Any repro logs?

marie: Contact: kate@polaris. Current rate limit = 100 req/min per key. They're spiking ~250 req/min, ~35% 429 rate. Expected ramp to ~400 req/min next week for pilot load. Quick log excerpt:

```
429 ERROR - /v1/complete - key=polaris-key-xxx - reqs=275 - window=60s - bucket=throttle_main
{"ts":"2026-03-19T14:03:22Z","status":429,"route":"/v1/complete","client_ip":"35.199.12.45"}
```

marie: Also asked if we can add eu-west-3 region for lower latency for EU legal teams. They want the change live before Monday.

devops-bot: infra-check: eu-west-3 has available headroom for a 48h burst of ~800 rpm for single-tenant jobs. Billing note: temporary overage may apply unless finance pre-approves.

amanda: We can provision a temporary bump to 600 rpm for 48h and add CIDR allowlist. Need exact IPs/CIDRs and an expiry date. Can also enable eu-west-3 edge canary for them. Will require audit log + change approval.

eli: Customer health FYI: Polaris went quiet during onboarding because of flakiness — renewal risk increases if pilot fails. Sales wants a 1:1 enablement session and weekly check-ins during the ramp. I'll be on the renewal thread.

marie: Kate provided IPs/CIDRs: ["35.199.12.0/24", "34.65.210.14"]. Requesting expiry 2026-04-10T00:00:00Z. They also asked for read-only per-route dashboard access for their SRE.

sam: I'll schedule the enablement session for tomorrow 10am PT. Amanda, putting the requested config into a support ticket body below — please confirm and I'll submit.

```
{
  "account_id": "polaris-223",
  "requested_by": "kate@polaris",
  "temp_rate_limits": {"global_rpm": "600", "per_key_rpm": "600", "tokens_per_minute": "500000"},
  "allowlist": ["35.199.12.0/24", "34.65.210.14"],
  "regions": ["eu-west-3"],
  "expires": "2026-04-10T00:00:00Z",
  "reason": "renewal-risk mitigation + enablement pilot",
  "requested_window": "48h"
}
```

amanda: Confirmed — the payload looks good. Will wait for finance sign-off for the overage. Tagging @finance. Also, we'll enable a canary route in eu-west-3 first and route 10% traffic.

devops-bot: Created support ticket INF-4782: https://redwood/support/INF-4782 - action items: apply temp limits, add CIDR, enable eu-west-3 canary, grant dashboard read-only.

eli: Adding this to the renewal playbook: we'll run a post-bump health check at +15m and daily for the week. I'll own the customer comms for renewal.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll run the enablement + send dashboard link to Kate right after the canary is live.

marie: Thanks — please add an audit log entry and ping Kate when live. Also capture feedback during the session and drop notes in the CRM.

devops-bot: INF-4782 update: applied 600rpm temporary limits, CIDR entries added, eu-west-3 canary enabled at 10%. Monitoring hooks active (5m).

amanda: Early metrics: error rate dropped from 35% -> 2% within 10m of the canary. CPU headroom holding. :tada:

marie: Great work team. Closing loop: schedule a post-mortem checklist if errors return and we'll keep renewal playbook updated.

sam: I'll upload the enablement recording and the per-route dashboard link to the ticket.

eli: Marking renewal risk as mitigated for now but we'll keep cadence.

marie: End of thread.
